check_is_oom_error: check if a caught exception is any type of out of memory error including CUDA, cuDNN, or CPU
check_is_cuda_out_of_memory: check if a caught exception is a CUDA out of memory RuntimeError
check_is_cudnn_snafu: check if a caught exception is a cuDNN not supported error
check_is_out_of_cpu_memory: check if a caught exception is a CPU allocator out of memory error
run_garbage_collection_cuda: run garbage collection to free Torch CUDA memory and empty the cache
